reason: Nine workbench defects from the round-4 audit. (1) NativeCheckpointService.preview classified any non-existent path as missing and restore wrote through symlinks with Path.write_bytes, so a checkpoint restore could create files outside the project; preview now lstat-walks every component (a symlink or non-directory parent is a conflict) and restore opens the directory chain with O_NOFOLLOW, writes a private temp file and os.replace()s it in. (7) A debug session whose websocket never attached held the project for the full hour; DebugService now closes unattached sessions after DEBUG_ATTACH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and exposes a ticket-authorised stop() behind DELETE /debug-sessions/{id}. (8) list/search/preview/rename/delete/promote/reset ran the filesystem work on the event loop; the routes now await asyncio.to_thread. (11) preview strict-decoded a 256 KiB byte cut and reported valid UTF-8 as invalid; it now uses an incremental decoder and reports the bytes actually decoded. (12) search parked one open directory fd per pending folder; it now keeps a stack of relative paths and opens one directory at a time, treating EMFILE/ENFILE as truncation. (14) the checkpoint preview route returned 500 for NativeCheckpointError; it maps to 409 like capture/restore. (18) every successful upload recorded FileNotFoundError catches (absent destination on create, temp name already consumed by replace/link); those are now silent expected paths. (19) the editor's TextDecoder stripped a UTF-8 BOM and saves dropped it; the buffer remembers the BOM and re-emits it. (21) editor search scanned node_modules/.git; it now honours WORKSPACE_SEARCH_EXCLUDES and reports skipped_directories. Proven by the new tests in test_native_checkpoints.py (symlink/parent-symlink/missing restore, preview 409), test_workspace.py (character-boundary preview, peak directory fds, ignore list, no recorded catches on save, all seven routes off the loop), test_debugger.py (attach deadline, stop ticket, DELETE route) and CodeEditorPanel.test.tsx (BOM preserved on save); each failed on origin/main.
exclusions: Frontend: only the editor and persistence vitest files (BOM buffer flag). No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through api.py) does not exercise checkpoint restore through symlinks, debug attach deadlines, threaded workspace handlers or the editor BOM; the Python and vitest tests drive them directly. No full suites.
